newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures rise after bid raised - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures rise after bid raised - Feb 13.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures prices rose in overnight activity Thurday, after a buyer lifted his bid and prompted sellers to raise prices, brokers said.
Traders in the after-hours market saw March crude oil trade $22.25 a barrel, up 23 cents a barrel from the final daytime level, while 944 lots changed hands for March contracts.
"People saw higher levels and started profit-taking," one broker said, attributing the market rise to a buyer who asked to purchase 98 lots at $22.17 early in the after-hours session.
Front-month gasoline futures climbed 0.67 cents a gallon to 63.85 cents, with 68 lots traded in the nearby month.
One broker expected energy futures to hold these levels Friday.
March heating oil increased 0.73 cents a gallon to 60.65 cents a gallon, amid volume of 100 lots in March and 181 overall.
